$comment: Single source of truth for the focused reference-video excerpts the benchmark laboratory reconstructs. Every window is capped at 20 seconds: one complete causal sequence is enough to test the target craft without repeatedly rendering lecture pauses. scripts/fetch-benchmark-media.sh reads this to download (yt-dlp) and slice (ffmpeg) the local, git-ignored media under .reference-sources/media/; the TypeScript manifests import it so manifest timing and extracted frames can never drift apart. Times are seconds in the source video. frameFps is the extraction rate for the lab's frame-accurate reference player.
